_help.commands: Each command is {"run": [args...], "in_container": true|false, "cwd": "folder under ai-attack-mapper"}. null = not available yet: classify/import stop the cycle (the gate needs the Mapper), playbooks/evaluate are skipped and logged.
_help.placeholders: {python} {root} {cycle_dir} {cycle_dir_c} {db} {db_c} {base} {mapper_db} {mapper_db_c}; classify also {ids_file} {ids_file_c} {round}; import also {mapper_run} {round}; playbooks {mapper_run} {round}; evaluate {base_round} {candidate_round} {candidate} {mapper_run}. *_c = path inside the container.
_help.mapper_db: path to the database Gladwin's runner writes to (mounted read-only into the container at /app/mapper_src for the import)
_help.mapper_run_regex: how the Mapper run id is found in the classify output (last match wins)
_help.extra_seen: more files whose prompts count as seen: replay-set style .json, or gate.py --out .jsonl files from hardening done by hand (e.g. the v6 eligible.jsonl from the seed-42 round)

_examples._note: classify: argument names are placeholders until Gladwin's live runner is on the branch.
